card.line: Sodom was a wicked city on the well-watered plain of the Jordan, where Lot made his home and which God destroyed with sulfur and fire.

moments.title: Lot Settles Near Sodom
moments.text: Lot looked over the well-watered plain and chose it for himself. He pitched his tent toward Sodom, though its men were wicked and sinned greatly against the LORD.

moments.title: Lot Is Carried Off
moments.text: Four kings took the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah. They also carried off Lot, who was living in Sodom. Abram rescued him, and the king of Sodom went out to meet Abram afterward.

moments.title: Abraham Pleads for Sodom
moments.text: The LORD said the outcry against Sodom was great. Abraham asked if He would sweep away the righteous with the wicked, and the LORD said He would spare the city for the sake of the righteous found there.

moments.title: Angels Visit Lot
moments.text: Two angels came to Sodom, and Lot welcomed them into his house. That night the men of the city surrounded the house, and the angels struck them with blindness.

moments.title: Sodom Destroyed
moments.text: The LORD rained sulfur and fire on Sodom and Gomorrah from the heavens. Abraham saw smoke rising like smoke from a furnace, and God remembered him and brought Lot out.
